title: Russian Missile and Drone Barrage Kills 8, Wounds 37 Across Seven Oblasts
detail: Russia launched a combined ballistic missile, cruise missile and drone attack overnight into September 22, striking industrial and civilian sites across Dnipropetrovsk, Kharkiv, Donetsk, Zaporizhzhia, Kherson, Kyiv and Poltava oblasts — 22 locations in total. At least 8 people were killed and 37 wounded. The heaviest toll was in Dnipropetrovsk Oblast, where ballistic missiles hit industrial facilities in Dnipro, Kryvyi Rih and Pavlohrad; a strike on the Interpipe plant in Dnipro killed 4 employees and halted production. A separate strike on Katerynivka in Kharkiv Oblast killed a 45-year-old woman and wounded a 13-year-old boy. One person was killed and 11 wounded across Donetsk Oblast (Kramatorsk, Sloviansk, Krasnotorka, Druzhkivka), and one was killed and 9 wounded, including a child, in Zaporizhzhia city and district. A Naftogaz facility in Poltava Oblast was also struck; no casualties were reported there.

title: Ukrainian Drones Strike Samara and Ufa Oil Refineries Deep Inside Russia
detail: Ukrainian long-range drones struck the Kuibyshev oil refinery in Samara Oblast (about 910 km from the Ukrainian border) and the Bashneft-UNPZ refinery in Ufa, Republic of Bashkortostan (about 1,300 km from the border) overnight September 21-22. Fires broke out at both sites; Ukraine's General Staff said the AVT-5 primary distillation unit at the Samara plant was likely damaged. The strikes are the latest in Kyiv's campaign against Russia's refining industry, which has contributed to nationwide fuel shortages in Russia over the summer. At least one person was killed and 15 others injured in the wider wave of overnight Ukrainian drone attacks across Russia.

title: Zelenskyy and Trump Discuss Energy Ceasefire at UN, but Kyiv Disputes Trump's Claim of a Deal
detail: President Zelenskyy and President Trump held a roughly 40-minute bilateral meeting on the sidelines of the UN General Assembly in New York on September 22. Zelenskyy said Ukraine is ready for an "energy ceasefire" — halting strikes on Russian energy infrastructure — if Russia stops targeting Ukraine's energy system, and urged Trump to organize a trilateral meeting with Putin. Trump told reporters that Ukraine and Russia had agreed to halt strikes on each other's energy infrastructure, but Ukrainian officials said they had not been informed of any such deal. Zelenskyy separately accused Putin of using fighters recruited from 47 countries to sustain Russia's war effort.
